examples.title: Require a validated title at a call site
limitations: acceptTitle returns a string; this example does not run an HTTP server or write to a database.
The compiler tracks declared proof requirements; the validation predicate still needs review and behavior tests.

broken.replacement:
fn createTitle(raw: String) -> String =
  acceptTitle raw

tests: empty and short titles are rejected

claims.text: An unchecked string cannot satisfy acceptTitle's declared TitleSafe requirement.
Calling checkTitle before acceptTitle supplies the required proof for the checked value.
The example's executed tests accept lengths 4 and 120 and reject empty, 3-character and 121-character titles.
These results concern the declared proof and the tested boundary cases; they do not establish arbitrary business correctness or API security.
